Short note before the call — a couple of commercial clarifications:

1) Pricing tiers: The CPPO SKU we’re proposing is a usage-based SKU (tokens) with tranche discounts at $50k, $150k, $350k monthly commit. I’ll bring the price-table and per-token examples to the review.

2) Marketplace fees: AWS will surface a marketplace fee line item; for co-sell attribution to work we need ResellCo to accept the marketplace billing flow and confirm payer entity. If ResellCo prefers to invoice separately we’ll need a custom billing arrangement (slower).

3) Entitlements: To ensure co-sell credit, we need the HubSpot deal linked to the AWS Marketplace listing (I’ve added the HubSpot link to the checklist).

See you at 09:00 PST.
